# nemau compute instance create

Create an instance.

The size is either --flavor or the three --vcpus, --ram and --disk values: the
API rejects a partial custom size. --flavor additionally requires the
"compute-flavors" organization feature.

## Usage

```
nemau compute instance create [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --description string       free-form description
      --disk int                 disk in GB (10-5000)
      --flavor string            flavor id
      --image string             image id (required)
      --key-name string          SSH keypair name
      --name string              instance name (required)
      --network string           network to attach
      --ram int                  memory in MB (1024-262144)
      --security-group strings   security group (repeatable)
      --service-level string     service level
      --vcpus int                number of vCPUs (1-64)
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
